The preferred reliever therapy for adults with asthma to reduce exacerbation risk is as-needed low-dose ICS-formoterol. According to the Global Strategy for Asthma Management (GINA, 2024), even at the mildest step of treatment, this combination is preferred over short-acting beta-agonists alone [citation]. 

No other clinical guidelines were found relevant to answer your question directly; however, this therapy has been shown to reduce exacerbation risk in asthma patients. It's important to consult a healthcare professional for personalized recommendations.
